answer: At a ferry desk, each identity posts a 40-unit willow bond locked for ten epochs. Before any vote counts, the agent must collect a one-time nonce from three non-adjacent clerks and return a cipher receipt that binds that nonce to one hardware key. A zephyr of coordinated sign-ups stays cheap until this errand: a farm must obtain that many keys, and any two receipts that share a key or arrive inside a 90-second clerk window are burned together with the bond. Honest agents reclaim the bond after epoch ten.
